summary: Defines a Management Information Base (MIB) module for monitoring the Name Server function of a Fibre Channel network. The Name Server lets Fibre Channel ports register and look up names and attributes. It is a proposed standard for use with network management protocols such as SNMP.

eli5.summary: A phone book for a storage network. This document says how a management tool can read that phone book to see who is listed.

questions: snmp mib for fibre channel names
